newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Credit Communal shares to list at 2,675 Bf.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Credit Communal shares to list at 2,675 Bf.

text.p: Belgian Credit Communal de Belgique/Gemeentekrediet Holding will be listed on the Brussels bourse at 2,675 francs a share, Credit Communal and Morgan Stanley said in an announcement in Belgium's financial newspapers on Wednesday.
A public offer of 3,212,507 shares was heavily oversubscribed and closed a day early last Tuesday.
The announcement said 4,112,507 shares had been allocated in the public share offer, and that a total 12,666,454 shares would be listed on the Brussels forward market.
The 2,675-francs-a-share figure had been the maximum price announced previously by Credit Communal. The shares will be quoted from today, Wednesday.
The listing is part of CCB's plan to join forces with French Credit Local de France to create Europe's 22nd largest banking group.
The joint banking operation will operate internationally under the name DEXIA, and the Credit Communal Holding shares will list under the name DEXIA-CC.
Small subscribers would be guaranteed a minimum 20 shares, the announcement added.
